parameters.query:
select a.id as appointment_id, a.start_at, c.phone_e164, c.id as contact_id, conv.id as conversation_id
from wa_n8n.appointments a
join wa_n8n.conversations conv on conv.id = a.conversation_id
join wa_n8n.contacts c on c.id = a.contact_id
where a.start_at between now() + interval '23 hours' and now() + interval '25 hours'
  and a.status in ('agendado','confirmado')
  and c.do_not_contact = false
  and not exists (
    select 1 from wa_n8n.events e
    where e.event_type = 'reminder_sent'
      and e.payload->>'kind' = '24h'
      and e.payload->>'appointment_id' = a.id::text
  );

insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, conversation_id, payload, created_at)
values (
  'reminder_sent',
  '{{$json.contact_id}}'::uuid,
  '{{$json.conversation_id}}'::uuid,
  jsonb_build_object('kind','24h','appointment_id','{{$json.appointment_id}}'),
  now()
);

parameters.bodyParametersJson: ={{ { number: ('' + ($json.phone_e164 || '')).replace(/\D/g, ''), text: 'Lembrete: seu agendamento é em 24h. Responda SIM para confirmar. Quer falar com atendente? (Digite ATENDENTE)' } }}

parameters.query:
select conv.id as conversation_id, c.id as contact_id, c.phone_e164,
       1 as next_stage, 'triage_15m' as kind
from wa_n8n.conversations conv
join wa_n8n.contacts c on c.id = conv.contact_id
where conv.followup_stage = 0
  and c.do_not_contact = false
  and conv.needs_human = false
  and conv.last_outbound_at <= now() - interval '15 minutes'
  and (conv.last_inbound_at is null or conv.last_inbound_at < conv.last_outbound_at)

union all

select conv.id as conversation_id, c.id as contact_id, c.phone_e164,
       2 as next_stage, 'triage_24h' as kind
from wa_n8n.conversations conv
join wa_n8n.contacts c on c.id = conv.contact_id
where conv.followup_stage = 1
  and c.do_not_contact = false
  and conv.needs_human = false
  and conv.last_outbound_at <= now() - interval '24 hours'
  and (conv.last_inbound_at is null or conv.last_inbound_at < conv.last_outbound_at)

union all

select conv.id as conversation_id, c.id as contact_id, c.phone_e164,
       3 as next_stage, 'triage_72h' as kind
from wa_n8n.conversations conv
join wa_n8n.contacts c on c.id = conv.contact_id
where conv.followup_stage = 2
  and c.do_not_contact = false
  and conv.needs_human = false
  and conv.last_outbound_at <= now() - interval '72 hours'
  and (conv.last_inbound_at is null or conv.last_inbound_at < conv.last_outbound_at);

insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, conversation_id, payload, created_at)
values (
  'reminder_sent',
  '{{$json.contact_id}}'::uuid,
  '{{$json.conversation_id}}'::uuid,
  jsonb_build_object('kind','{{$json.kind}}'),
  now()
);
